nodes.label: W-260 — six more Phase 2 items seated
nodes.rationale: Built by r4-b6.py, BUILD120 → BUILD121 main, with the live golden set falling to 85 as r2-26c2 is held.

nodes.label: Register 1865 — a correction announced in one chapter and recorded nowhere
nodes.rationale: The inverse of the store's own no-silent-change rule: an entry is owed for a change the volume already announces, and '18.5' occurs zero times in the Register.

nodes.label: Register 1866 — a row truncated at an escaped pipe
nodes.rationale: The escape was lost and the bar read as a cell boundary, and the half that carries the argument is the half that went: that |X| stays fixed while the box grows is the whole reason a derived coordinate cannot repair a blindness.

nodes.label: Register 1867 — a committed prediction with no Register home
nodes.source_location: Sc VI prediction, three main-volume sites
nodes.rationale: A prediction is the one claim the record exists to hold, because it is what a later measurement attaches to — and this one has nowhere to attach. A volume can be revised; a prediction cannot be un-made.

nodes.label: Register 1868 — §F.4.1's two ratios, one of them never measured
nodes.rationale: The withdrawal ratio has a value from Ruling 25; the method ratio is named once, in register 296's own heading, whose body gives no figure.

nodes.label: An absence asserted from a case-sensitive grep
nodes.rationale: The draft claimed zero occurrences; register 296 prints THE METHOD RATIO in upper case. close_rebank.py refused the seated build because a failing instrument is not a re-bank, and it was discarded and rebuilt — the third discard in this leg. An absence is the hardest claim to make and the easiest to make carelessly.

nodes.label: A pinned list cannot survive the record growing into it
nodes.rationale: r2-26c2 asserts the registers naming the method ratio are exactly [296]; entry 1868 names it, so the true answer is [296, 1868] and the instrument refuses — not because either is wrong. The store's answer is a successor rather than an edit, with the four standing deviations carried unchanged and the HELD row recording it.

nodes.label: Register 1869 — an owed item that left the list silently
nodes.rationale: Both owed items are closed and only one closure is recorded: §32.4.1's placeholder occurs nowhere with no entry saying so.

nodes.label: Register 1870 — the false-universal class measured rather than asserted
nodes.rationale: Two of three sites are scoped by their own words; the third does not resolve from the page, because the same passage supplies both readings — it scopes the argument to ℛ, the envelopes and Birkhoff, which excludes §23.7, and calls Chapters 6, 10, 14 and 23 four measurements of one thing, which includes it. The scope is subject matter and is not chosen here.

nodes.label: The parity guard's second catch in six builds
nodes.rationale: Entry 1869 was drafted with 35 asterisks — a long quotation whose closing delimiter lost a character, the same shape as the first catch. The guard stopped the build before anything was written.
